legume_intercropping.name: Legume-based intercropping
legume_intercropping.description: Add compatible legumes alongside the main crop to diversify roots and biological inputs.

cover_cropping.name: Cover cropping with reduced soil disturbance
cover_cropping.description: Maintain living or residue cover between crop cycles and reduce bare-soil exposure.

agroforestry.name: Agroforestry / tree-crop integration
agroforestry.description: Integrate appropriately selected perennial trees or shrubs with crops to create a more structurally diverse production system.

native_hedgerows.name: Native flowering hedgerows / habitat corridors
native_hedgerows.description: Restore native flowering field margins and connected habitat strips for pollinators and other beneficial organisms.

water_retention_management.name: Soil-water retention management
water_retention_management.description: Use mulching, contour-aligned ground cover and reduced bare-soil exposure to retain water in the root zone.

soil_ph_management.name: Targeted soil pH management
soil_ph_management.description: Correct strongly acidic or alkaline soil conditions based on a soil test and crop requirements.

pesticide_reduction.name: Targeted pesticide-risk reduction and integrated pest management
pesticide_reduction.description: Reduce unnecessary broad-spectrum pesticide exposure through monitoring, thresholds and targeted controls.

habitat_restoration.name: Native habitat restoration and connectivity
habitat_restoration.description: Restore native habitat patches and connections where land conversion or habitat loss is the dominant pressure.

riparian_buffers.name: Native riparian buffer restoration
riparian_buffers.description: Restore vegetated buffers along watercourses to intercept runoff and improve aquatic and terrestrial habitat.
